32-byte source -> C+38+32*index; cmd8205 takes first cache byte and copies entire byte to C+5272 and C.ptr[5260]+6; index26 => cache C+4f8
type2 exchange return0 permits cache/unpack; nonzero branches to5315e2f0; observed ordinary exchange return is0 at52f182ac
ImageTuning packs output argument through53135488->5313542c->5313432c. r3=output+1000; store531346e4 is output+1272, not established C+5272.
Generic forwarding entry suppresses call when its byte9b!=0; wrapper suppresses cmd8205 when C+52f3!=0 (only high-nibblea000 exception). Caller derives cmd from incoming r1, not a fixed8205 literal.

limitations: No vendor name for capability bit6, lens ID mapping or safe forced actuator policy is established. Entire capability byte is copied, including bit6; these writers do not mask or force just that bit.

The metadata command8205 is proven. A concrete upstream UI/event that issues this command has not been identified; generic forwarding accepts incoming r1. Exact MOVW8205 candidates outside lookup/unpack were full26408205 messages and were not equated with this16-bit command.
Cache copy uses signed index>86hex as its sole observed range rejection. Synthetic index-1 writes C+18 but lookup8205 produces26hex, not-1. No claim of runtime negative index producer.

Packet63 helper allocates32-byte buffers, sends32 bytes and copies min(requested_length,32) bytes back; handler then caches32 bytes. Input buffer capacity must support that operation. No actual malformed caller or out-of-bounds event was observed.

Packet63 normal path returns0 after receive/free. Its WaitLensCpuControl return is unused, as is WaitLensInfo at the prior packet62 import call. Assertion/error paths inside wait or lower transport may stop execution; this is not proof that a real failed transaction updates capability.

Tests execute original selected handler/lookup/exchange/cache/unpack branches with synthetic external allocation, memcpy/memset, event clear, send/receive/wait/free stubs. One forced nonzero exchange test checks a structural branch only; observed original exchange ordinary return is0.

Four non-AF checks execute two disjoint instruction fragments, not the full EdgeEnhancement packer. Previous R2y evidence independently names the module; this pass establishes the exact output+1272 address expression.
Genuine angr C retains inferred types and condition-code artifacts. ARM, source hashes and scoped numerical tests are authoritative. No firmware changes, hardware or media IO were performed.
Bounded searches do not establish absence of additional capability producers or aliases elsewhere.
